name: AWQ scale + GPTQ in scaled space
tagline: Search a per-channel AWQ scale $s$ (with $H$-diagonal-weighted error), then run GPTQ on $W{\cdot}\mathrm{diag}(s)$ with the transformed Hessian $\mathrm{diag}(1/s) H \mathrm{diag}(1/s)$.
diff_from_baseline: Replaces AWQ's clip-search and GPTQ's plain Hessian with a hybrid: AWQ-style scale search uses $H$-diagonal as the importance metric, and GPTQ then runs in the scaled space with the correctly transformed Hessian (no separate clip search).

name: Scale-grid + clip-grid GPTQ
tagline: Search a 26-point grid over $(\alpha, \text{clip})$ for per-channel scaling and clip ratio (using $H$-diagonal-weighted error), then run GPTQ in the scaled space.
diff_from_baseline: Augments GPTQ with a 26-point joint search over per-channel scale exponent and per-group clip ratio; the search uses an $H^{-1}$-diagonal-weighted error rather than AWQ's $X^\top X$ output error.

name: Whitened group quant + bias correction
tagline: Mild $\bar x^{1/4}$ column whitening, percentile-clipped per-group min-max quant, and one-step activation-weighted bias correction inside each group.
init_recovers: RTN-per-group at $c=1$, clip ratio $=1$, no bias
diff_from_baseline: No GPTQ error feedback; instead, mildly whitens columns by $h_d^{1/4}$, clips each group at a percentile (looser at 4-bit, tighter at 3-bit), and computes a single activation-weighted bias offset per group before re-rounding.

name: GPTQ + per-group scale grid refine
tagline: Standard column-wise GPTQ followed by an activation-weighted scale-multiplier grid search ($\times 0.88\ldots1.12$) per quantization group.
init_recovers: Plain GPTQ if $\mu^\star = 1$ for every group
diff_from_baseline: Keeps GPTQ's column-wise error compensation and adds a post-hoc per-group scale grid search using activation-weighted MSE; unlike AWQ, only re-quantizes against the original $W$ and ignores cross-group interactions.

name: Activation-aware scaled GPTQ
tagline: Per-channel scale $\alpha = (\overline{|x|})^\gamma$, transform Hessian by $\mathrm{diag}(1/\alpha)\,H\,\mathrm{diag}(1/\alpha)$, then run GPTQ in the scaled space.
diff_from_baseline: Replaces AWQ's grid-searched scale with a fixed $\alpha = \overline{|x|}^{1/2}$ per-channel scale and feeds it through GPTQ with the correctly conjugated Hessian $\mathrm{diag}(1/\alpha)\,H\,\mathrm{diag}(1/\alpha)$.
